question: How many U.S. banks will fail in August 2026?

factors.description: Recent US bank failures are rare; calm regime dominates with monthly rate ~0.35, making 0 the modal outcome.
2026 has had at least one failure by May, indicating a non-zero but low pace consistent with occasional single-month failures.
Failures cluster in waves, but no active banking crisis is known as of mid-2026, keeping high-count tail buckets very low.

summary: Single-month US bank failure count question. Bank failures are rare in the current calm regime (2021:0, 2022:0, 2023:5 crisis, 2024:2, 2025:~3, 2026:≥1 by May). No active banking crisis known as of July 2026, so status quo favors 0 failures in August. A Poisson-mixture Monte Carlo (92% calm λ=0.35 / 7% elevated λ=1.5 / 1% crisis λ=6) yields 0:0.67, 1:0.25, 2-3:0.07, 4-6:0.01, 7+:0.004. I nudge the 7+ tail slightly for wave-clustering safety. Most likely outcome is 0.
